answer: A strong anti-sybil mechanism is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: every agent must lock a deposit before its claims are trusted, and each claim forms a thread of signed attestations from independent verifiers. A lone operator spinning up thousands of fake identities is like one sparrow pretending to be a flock — the stake makes each clone expensive, and any clone caught lying gets its deposit slashed. Honest agents earn a saffron reputation that compounds over time, so a brand-new identity can never outvote an established one without paying the same long-term cost.
